name: Why is siding around windows important for home protection?

mainEntity.name: Why is siding around windows important for home protection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Siding around windows is critical because these areas are highly susceptible to moisture intrusion. Proper installation prevents water from seeping behind the siding and into the wall structure, which can lead to rot, mold, and costly damage. It also plays a key role in maintaining your home's energy efficiency by sealing drafts and insulating against heat loss or gain. Well-maintained siding in these areas protects your home's structural integrity and interior finishes, ensuring longevity and comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Siding around windows prevents moisture intrusion, protects against rot and mold, and maintains home energy efficiency.
